sections.heading: Purpose of this screen
body: Profile brings together your account level and XP, contacts and plant sharing, notification preferences, appearance settings and support.
It allows the user to control both personal data and how the Flovers app behaves on a daily basis.

sections.heading: Account
body: The Account section displays basic account information such as the registered email address and account creation date.
From this section, the user can change the email address (confirmation with the current password is required), change the current password, log out, or permanently delete the account.
Confirm account deletion with your current password. This permanently removes your account and its plants, reminders, tasks, readings and devices.

sections.heading: Account level and XP
body: The Account tile shows your current level, rank and progress towards the next level. Levels run from 1 to 100. A rank’s name and badge stay the same for each group of ten levels.

Completing eligible care tasks earns XP. Early levels need less XP, while higher levels require progressively more. Profile refreshes the current balance; there is no separate XP pop-up after every task.

sections.heading: How XP is awarded
body: The first eligible completion each day gives 100 XP, followed by 50, 30 and 20 XP. The next five eligible completions give 10 XP each, up to 250 XP per UTC day. Only tasks due today or already overdue qualify.

The same plant and care type can earn XP only once per UTC day. Repeating a completion does not grant XP again, and completing future tasks early earns none. When a caregiver completes a shared task, the caregiver receives the eligible XP, not the owner.

sections.heading: Ranks from level 1 to 100
body: 1–10 · Seedling
11–20 · Sprout Keeper
21–30 · Leaf Lover
31–40 · Budding Gardener
41–50 · Plant Nurturer
51–60 · Green Thumb
61–70 · Garden Guardian
71–80 · Botanical Expert
81–90 · Master Grower
91–100 · Plant Legend

sections.heading: Sharing from Profile
body: The Sharing tile sits below Account. It shows accepted contacts and pending incoming requests, with buttons for Contacts and Shared plants. Use these screens to manage invitations and plant access.

sections.heading: Notifications
body: Notifications has Email, Phone and Shared sections. Daily summaries for your own plants can be enabled separately for email and push, with one delivery time per channel in your account’s notification timezone.

Email and Phone each have an additional checkbox for tasks due today on plants shared with you. These options start off, work independently of summaries for your own plants, and use the same delivery time as the corresponding channel. When both are enabled, your own and shared due tasks are combined into one daily message per channel.

Shared-task reminders include active view-only shares as well as shares that allow task completion. Access is checked again before delivery. Expiry, removal of access or removal of the contact stops these reminders.

The next-day follow-up option covers only your own plants’ unfinished tasks from yesterday. It uses the channel’s configured time; it is not a timer set for exactly 24 hours after the first notification.

The Shared section controls a different event: someone else completing a task for a plant you own. Its email and push checkboxes start off and apply to all plants you share. These notifications are sent after completion rather than at the daily summary time; they are account preferences, not settings in the plant-sharing form.

sections.heading: Settings
body: The Settings section controls general application behavior and appearance.

Available options include language selection, date and time format, temperature units (Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin), measurement units (metric or imperial), and Floating Action Button (FAB) position (left or right).
The user can also customize the app appearance by selecting a background image, tile theme (light or dark), and tile transparency level.

sections.heading: Support
body: The Support section provides direct access to assistance from the Flovers team.
The user can contact support for help or report a bug directly from this screen.
Reporting issues helps improve the stability and quality of the application.
